given_vocabulary.damage-result-rewrite: A stage that rewrites the RESULT of a damage event (substitute or augment what damage does) instead of the amount — the slot CR 120.3 hardcodes for lifelink/wither/infect/toxic.
given_vocabulary.progress-track: A game-maintained monotonic value with thresholds (day/night, speed) advanced by turn-based actions or inherent triggers; statics read it.
given_vocabulary.attachment-relation: A first-class attached-to edge between an object and a legal host (object or player) with legality predicate and violation policy.
given_vocabulary.cost-modification-hook: A permission that edits how the generic/colored mana of an already-determined total cost is paid (601.2f-h) — neither an additional nor an alternative cost.
given_vocabulary.face-down-objects: A primitive for objects existing face down (708): put/cast face down as a 2/2, secret-identity memory, and a special action to turn face up.

keywords.name: Absorb
keywords.how: A prevention effect: prevent N of any damage a source would deal to this creature (per source, per instance).

keywords.name: Affinity
keywords.how: A cost-reduction static on the stack: the spell costs {1} less per qualifying permanent you control.

keywords.name: Afflict
keywords.how: Triggered ability: 'whenever this creature becomes blocked' trigger that makes the defending player lose N life.

keywords.name: Afterlife
keywords.how: Triggered ability: dies (put into graveyard from battlefield) trigger that creates N 1/1 Spirit tokens with flying.

keywords.name: Aftermath
keywords.how: Three statics: permission to cast this half from the graveyard, a restriction barring casting from other zones, and an exile replacement when it leaves the stack.

keywords.name: Amplify
keywords.how: An enters-with-counters static parameterized by a reveal action (reveal cards sharing a creature type, gain N counters per card).

keywords.name: Annihilator
keywords.how: Triggered ability: whenever this creature attacks, defending player sacrifices N permanents; attack trigger + forced sacrifice keyword-action.

keywords.name: Ascend
keywords.how: Spell ability (instant/sorcery) or static ability (permanent) that checks a permanent-count condition and grants the city's blessing designation (itself a marker).

keywords.name: Assist
keywords.how: Modifies how the generic-mana component of the already-determined total cost is paid (601.2g-h): lets another chosen player pay any amount of that generic mana before you pay. Same pay-substitution hook category as Delve/Convoke, differing only in who pays; given the cost-modification-hook primitive it composes.

keywords.name: Aura Swap
keywords.how: An activated ability that exchanges this Aura permanent with an Aura card in your hand (cost + zone-exchange action, no effect if either half fails).

keywords.name: Awaken
keywords.how: Static alternative-cost permission plus a conditional spell ability that, if the awaken cost was paid, puts N counters on a land and animates it.

keywords.name: Backup
keywords.how: ETB triggered ability: put N +1/+1 counters on target creature and, if another creature, grant it this card's printed non-backup abilities until end of turn — trigger + place-counters + ability-grant.

keywords.name: Banding
keywords.how: Rewrites attacker declaration (band formation, shared-blocking) and reassigns who chooses combat damage division (702.22j/k are explicit exceptions to 510.1c/d), reshaping blocking and assignment machinery.

keywords.name: Bargain
keywords.how: Static on the stack: optional additional cost to sacrifice an artifact/enchantment/token, with linked 'was bargained' memory referenced by other abilities — additional-cost choice plus a was-X flag.

keywords.name: Battle Cry
keywords.how: Triggered ability: whenever this creature attacks, each other attacking creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn; attack trigger + mass temporary buff.

keywords.name: Bestow
keywords.how: Static ability: an alternative cost to cast the creature as an Aura (type-changing static granting enchant creature), reverting to a creature on illegal target/unattach.

keywords.name: Blitz
keywords.how: Static alternative cost, a static creating a delayed sacrifice trigger if that cost was paid, and a static granting haste plus a dies-draw triggered ability.

keywords.name: Bloodthirst
keywords.how: A conditional enters-with-counters static gated on whether an opponent was dealt damage this turn (enters-with counters over a damage-this-turn record).

keywords.name: Boast
keywords.how: An activated ability with an activation restriction (only if this creature attacked this turn, only once per turn).

keywords.name: Bushido
keywords.how: A trigger on blocking/becoming blocked granting a +N/+N until-end-of-turn pump.

keywords.name: Buyback
keywords.how: Optional additional cost as the spell is cast plus a replacement: if paid, the spell returns to hand instead of the graveyard as it resolves; composes from cost-modification + replacement effect.

keywords.name: Cascade
keywords.how: Cast-trigger on the stack: exile from top until a nonland with lower mana value, may cast it for free, then bottom the rest randomly; cast trigger + exile sequence + conditional free cast + bottom-random.

keywords.name: Casualty
keywords.how: Static additional cost (optionally sacrifice a creature with power N+) plus a cast trigger that copies the spell (new targets) if that cost was paid.

keywords.name: Champion
keywords.how: Two linked triggered abilities: ETB sacrifice-unless-exile-another-object, and LTB return-the-exiled-card; ETB/LTB triggers + exile/return keyword-actions + linked-ability memory.

keywords.name: Changeling
keywords.how: Characteristic-defining ability setting creature types to every creature type, working in all zones; a CDA over the type-line characteristic (rubric: NOT a marker).

keywords.name: Cipher
keywords.how: Spell ability that exiles the card encoded on a creature, plus a granted triggered ability (on combat damage to a player, copy and optionally cast the encoded card for free) — all statics/triggers + keyword actions (exile/copy/cast).

keywords.name: Cleave
keywords.how: Static granting an alternative cost, plus a text-changing effect (rule 612) removing bracketed text when that cost was paid.

keywords.name: Companion
keywords.how: Functions outside the game and uses a dedicated special action (116.2g) to move a card from outside the game into hand; outside-game functioning plus the special action are structural pipeline machinery no static/trigger composition reproduces.

keywords.name: Compleated
keywords.how: Static replacement effect on entering loyalty counters: reduces them by two per Phyrexian mana symbol for which life was paid.

keywords.name: Conspire
keywords.how: Static additional-cost option (tap two untapped creatures sharing a color) plus a linked cast-trigger that copies the spell if the conspire cost was paid; additional-cost + 'was paid' memory + cast trigger + copy-spell.

keywords.name: Convoke
keywords.how: For each colored/generic mana in the already-determined total cost, may tap an untapped creature of that color (or any creature for generic) rather than pay that mana; CR explicitly says it is neither additional nor alternative cost (702.51b). Same cost-modification-hook pay-substitution as Delve.

keywords.name: Craft
keywords.how: Activated sorcery-speed ability: cost + exile this permanent + exile materials: return this card to the battlefield transformed — composes a cost (with exile components) and a return-transformed action.

keywords.name: Crew
keywords.how: Activated ability of Vehicles: tap untapped creatures with total power N or more to make this an artifact creature until end of turn.

keywords.name: Cumulative Upkeep
keywords.how: Triggered ability: at-upkeep trigger placing an age counter, then a pay-[cost]-per-counter-or-sacrifice cost gate; composes from upkeep trigger + place counters + cost + sacrifice keyword action.

keywords.name: Cycling
keywords.how: Activated ability functioning from hand: '[Cost], Discard this card: Draw a card' — a cost (incl. discard keyword action) producing a draw.

keywords.name: Dash
keywords.how: Alternative casting cost static, a delayed triggered ability to return the permanent to hand at next end step, and a static haste grant while the dash cost was paid.

keywords.name: Daybound
keywords.how: Three statics that read the game day/night designation (a game-maintained state track advanced by the untap-step turn-based action, rule 731): enters transformed if night, transforms as it becomes night, can’t otherwise transform; given the day/night progress-track these are statics + forced transforms.

keywords.name: Deathtouch
keywords.how: Lethality is read prospectively: 510.1c treats any nonzero combat damage from a deathtouch source as lethal during assignment (702.2c), and the dedicated SBA 704.5h destroys any creature it has damaged. No composition of primitives reproduces the planning-time lethality rewrite.

keywords.name: Decayed
keywords.how: Static restriction (can't block) plus a triggered ability (attack trigger sacrificing it at end of combat).

keywords.name: Defender
keywords.how: Cant(Attack(This)) — removes the declare-attackers permission, checked by the restriction step (702.3b, 508.1c).

keywords.name: Delve
keywords.how: Static cost-payment alteration: for each generic mana in the total cost, may exile a graveyard card instead of paying. Decomposes given the cost-modification-hook primitive: a permission that edits how generic mana of an already-determined total cost is paid (it is neither additional nor alternative cost).

keywords.name: Demonstrate
keywords.how: Triggered ability: cast trigger that optionally copies the spell (new targets) and, if so, lets a chosen opponent copy it too.

keywords.name: Dethrone
keywords.how: Triggered ability: whenever this creature attacks the player with the most life, put a +1/+1 counter on it.

keywords.name: Devoid
keywords.how: Characteristic-defining ability setting the object's color to colorless; functions in all zones (like changeling). Composite CDA, not a marker.

keywords.name: Devour
keywords.how: Static ability: as this enters, may sacrifice any number of creatures and it enters with N +1/+1 counters per creature sacrificed; ETB replacement choosing sacrifices + enters-with counters + 'it devoured' count memory.

keywords.name: Disguise
keywords.how: Alternative-cost face-down cast (708) of the card as a 2/2 ward {2} face-down creature for {3}, plus a special action (116) to turn it face up for the disguise cost; given the face-down-objects primitive, alt-cost cast + turn-face-up.

keywords.name: Disturb
keywords.how: Static granting permission to cast the card transformed from the graveyard for an alternative cost, plus a replacement so it enters with its back face up.

keywords.name: Double Strike
keywords.how: Restructures the combat damage step itself: forces a first-strike damage step then a second combat damage step (510), changing turn/phase structure no primitive composition reproduces.

keywords.name: Dredge
keywords.how: A replacement effect on drawing: instead of drawing, mill N and return this card from graveyard to hand.

keywords.name: Echo
keywords.how: Triggered ability: at the beginning of your upkeep, if this came under your control since your last upkeep, sacrifice it unless you pay the cost; upkeep trigger + intervening-if + pay-or-sacrifice gate.

keywords.name: Embalm
keywords.how: Activated ability from the graveyard: [cost], exile this card: create a white no-mana-cost Zombie token copy; sorcery-speed restricted.

keywords.name: Emerge
keywords.how: Static alternative cost (pay [cost] and sacrifice a creature) plus a generic-mana cost reduction equal to the sacrificed creature's mana value.

keywords.name: Enchant
keywords.how: Static restriction on what an Aura spell may target and what an Aura may be attached to; pure target/attachment legality predicate.

keywords.name: Encore
keywords.how: Activated ability from the graveyard (cost + exile self) creating attacking haste token copies per opponent, sacrificed at next end step; sorcery-speed restriction.

keywords.name: Enlist
keywords.how: Optional cost to attack (508.1g) tapping an eligible creature, with a linked triggered ability (607.2h) granting +X/+0 — same template as exert (701.43d); 702.154b names both rules-native hooks explicitly.

keywords.name: Entwine
keywords.how: A modal-spell static letting you choose all modes for an additional cost (mode-choice override + additional cost, 601.2b/700.2).

keywords.name: Epic
keywords.how: A static restriction (you can't cast spells for the rest of the game) plus a delayed triggered ability copying this spell each upkeep with optional new targets.

keywords.name: Equip
keywords.how: Defined as an activated ability '[Cost]: Attach this permanent to target creature you control, activate only as a sorcery' — a cost + attach keyword action with a sorcery-speed timing restriction.

keywords.name: Escalate
keywords.how: Static additional-cost ability on modal spells: pay an extra [cost] per mode chosen beyond the first.

keywords.name: Escape
keywords.how: Static ability granting permission to cast the card from the graveyard for an alternative cost; 'escaped' is tracked memory, escape-with-counters is a replacement effect.

keywords.name: Eternalize
keywords.how: Activated ability from the graveyard: [cost], exile this card: create a black 4/4 no-mana-cost Zombie token copy; sorcery-speed restricted.

keywords.name: Evoke
keywords.how: Static alternative-cost permission (may cast for evoke cost) plus a linked ETB triggered ability that sacrifices it if the evoke cost was paid; alternative-cost + 'was paid' memory + ETB trigger sacrificing.

keywords.name: Evolve
keywords.how: Triggered ability: whenever a creature you control enters with greater power and/or toughness, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

keywords.name: Exalted
keywords.how: Triggered ability: whenever a creature you control attacks alone, that creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn; attacks-alone trigger (506.5 predicate) + temporary buff.

keywords.name: Exhaust
keywords.how: An activated ability with an 'activate only once' (per game) usage restriction — the existing activated-ability template plus an activation-count restriction.

keywords.name: Exploit
keywords.how: Triggered ability: when this creature enters, you may sacrifice a creature (sacrifice keyword action).

keywords.name: Extort
keywords.how: Triggered ability: whenever you cast a spell, optionally pay {W/B} to make each opponent lose 1 life and gain that much.

keywords.name: Fabricate
keywords.how: Triggered ability: when this enters, either put N +1/+1 counters on it or create N 1/1 Servo tokens.

keywords.name: Fading
keywords.how: Two abilities: enters with N fade counters, plus an upkeep trigger that removes a fade counter or sacrifices the permanent if it can't; composes from enters-with-counters + upkeep trigger + remove counter + sacrifice.

keywords.name: Fear
keywords.how: Cant(Block(b, This) where ¬(Artifact(b) ∨ Black(b))) — evasion restriction predicated on blocker characteristics (702.36b).

keywords.name: Firebending
keywords.how: Attack-triggered ability adding N {R} that doesn't empty as steps/phases end until end of combat — combat trigger + mana addition + a don't-lose-this-mana effect.

keywords.name: First Strike
keywords.how: Restructures the combat damage step: when present it splits combat damage into a first-strike step and a regular step (510), altering phase structure not reproducible from primitives.

keywords.name: Flanking
keywords.how: Triggered ability: whenever this becomes blocked by a creature without flanking, that blocker gets -1/-1; a become-blocked trigger producing a P/T-debuff effect.

keywords.name: Flash
keywords.how: May(Cast(This, window: instant-speed)) — widens the default 117.1a sorcery window (702.8a).

keywords.name: Flashback
keywords.how: Two statics: an alternative-cost casting permission from the graveyard (601.2b alt-cost rules) plus a replacement effect that exiles the card instead of letting it leave the stack.

keywords.name: Flying
keywords.how: Cant(Block(b, This) where ¬(Flying(b) ∨ Reach(b))) — evasion restriction over blocker abilities (702.9b).

keywords.name: For Mirrodin!
keywords.how: Triggered ability: 'when this Equipment enters, create a 2/2 Rebel token then attach this Equipment to it' — ETB trigger composing a create-token action and an attach action.

keywords.name: Forecast
keywords.how: An activated ability usable only from hand, restricted to your upkeep and once per turn, that reveals the card as a cost (activated ability + timing/zone restriction).

keywords.name: Foretell
keywords.how: Special action (116.2h) to pay {2} and exile the card face down, plus a static granting an alternative foretell cost to cast it later (601.2b, 601.2f-h). Not a 708 object: 708 covers only face-down spells and permanents (708.5 excludes other zones); face-down exile with look permission is native zone machinery (406.3-4), the same basis hideaway compiles to.

keywords.name: Fortify
keywords.how: Activated ability = [cost] : attach this Fortification to target land you control, with a sorcery-speed timing restriction; pure cost + keyword-action (attach) + targeting + timing permission.

keywords.name: Freerunning
keywords.how: Static alternative-cost permission predicated on a combat-damage condition (a player was dealt combat damage by your Assassin/commander this turn) — conditional alt-cost casting.

keywords.name: Frenzy
keywords.how: Triggered ability: when this creature attacks and isn't blocked, +N/+0 until end of turn; trigger condition + temporary P/T buff.

keywords.name: Fuse
keywords.how: Static casting permission letting you cast both halves of a split card as one spell with the combined cost and sequential resolution — a casting-mode choice plus cost composition, no new pipeline opcode.

keywords.name: Gift
keywords.how: Optional additional cost (choose an opponent) plus a triggered/spell ability whose effect (token, draw, etc.) happens if the gift cost was paid — additional-cost choice + conditional effect + was-paid memory.

keywords.name: Graft
keywords.how: An enters-with-N-counters static plus a trigger on another creature entering that may move a +1/+1 counter onto it.

keywords.name: Gravestorm
keywords.how: Triggered ability on the stack: when you cast this spell, copy it once per permanent put into a graveyard from the battlefield this turn (a counted game event) and optionally choose new targets; cast trigger + copy-spell action + per-event count.

keywords.name: Harmonize
keywords.how: Alternative-cost cast from graveyard (pay cost + tap a creature) with a generic cost reduction by the tapped creature's power and an exile-instead replacement when it leaves the stack — alt-cost + cost-reduction + replacement.

keywords.name: Haste
keywords.how: Lifts the 302.6/508.1a summoning-sickness restrictions so the creature may attack and use tap/untap abilities without continuous control since the turn began.

keywords.name: Haunt
keywords.how: A dies/resolution trigger that exiles the card haunting a target creature, establishing a haunt attachment relation that lets later triggers fire from exile.

keywords.name: Hexproof
keywords.how: Cant(Target(x, This) where Opponent(controller(x))) — asymmetric targeting restriction gated on source controller (702.11b).

keywords.name: Hidden Agenda
keywords.how: As the conspiracy is put into the command zone it is turned face down (variant-native, 905.4a — command zone, not 708) and a card name is secretly chosen as linked-ability memory (607.2d); a special action (116.2j) turns it face up. Every component is a rules-native hook the CR names explicitly.

keywords.name: Hideaway
keywords.how: Triggered ability: ETB look at top N, exile one face down (granting a look-permission) and bottom the rest in random order; ETB trigger + look/exile/bottom sequence + granted static ability.

keywords.name: Horsemanship
keywords.how: Cant(Block(b, This) where ¬Horsemanship(b)) — evasion restriction predicated on the horsemanship keyword (702.31b).

keywords.name: Impending
keywords.how: Alternative-cost cast + ETB replacement adding N time counters + static 'not a creature while it has a time counter' + end-step triggered counter removal — alt-cost + replacement + conditional static + trigger.

keywords.name: Improvise
keywords.how: For each generic mana in the already-determined total cost, may tap an untapped artifact rather than pay that mana; CR explicitly says it is neither additional nor alternative cost (702.126b). Same cost-modification-hook pay-substitution as Delve/Convoke.

keywords.name: Increment
keywords.how: Cast-triggered ability: when you cast a spell, if mana spent exceeds this creature's power or toughness, put a +1/+1 counter on it — spell-cast trigger with an intervening-if condition + place-counter.

keywords.name: Indestructible
keywords.how: Static “can’t be destroyed” restriction (702.12a/b): a “can’t” effect (614.17) that nulls the destroy keyword action for this permanent and exempts it from the lethal-damage SBA (704.5g). “Can’t” effects are statics in the rubric basis, so it composes as a static rule-modification rather than its own prospective machinery.

keywords.name: Infect
keywords.how: Static result substitution given the damage-result-rewrite stage: damage to a player becomes that many poison counters instead of life loss, and damage to a creature becomes -1/-1 counters instead of marked damage (CR 120.3b/120.3d).

keywords.name: Ingest
keywords.how: Triggered ability: on combat damage to a player, that player exiles the top card of their library (exile keyword action).

keywords.name: Intimidate
keywords.how: Cant(Block(b, This) where ¬(Artifact(b) ∨ SharesColor(b, This))) — evasion restriction predicated on blocker characteristics (702.13b).

keywords.name: Job Select
keywords.how: ETB triggered ability: create a 1/1 Hero token then attach this Equipment to it — ETB trigger composing create-token and attach actions.

keywords.name: Jump-Start
keywords.how: Two statics: permission to cast from graveyard with an additional discard cost, plus a replacement that exiles the card when it would leave the stack.

keywords.name: Kicker
keywords.how: Optional additional cost paid as the spell is cast, plus 'was kicked' memory that linked abilities reference; composes from cost-modification choice + a kicked flag.

keywords.name: Landwalk
keywords.how: Cant(Block(b, This) where Controls(DefendingPlayer, Land[type])) — conditional evasion restriction gated on the defending player's board state (702.14c).

keywords.name: Level Up
keywords.how: Activated ability = [cost] : put a level counter on this permanent, sorcery-speed only; cost + place-counter + timing restriction (level symbols themselves are separate static abilities).

keywords.name: Lifelink
keywords.how: Augments the damage RESULT (controller gains that much life in addition to other results) given the damage-result-rewrite stage; CR hardcodes this as 120.3f.

keywords.name: Living Metal
keywords.how: Conditional characteristic-defining static: 'during your turn this is an artifact creature in addition to its other types' — a type-adding CDA gated on the active-player turn, expressible as a static type-modification effect.

keywords.name: Living Weapon
keywords.how: Triggered ability: ETB create a 0/0 black Phyrexian Germ token then attach this Equipment to it; ETB trigger + create-token + attach keyword-action.

keywords.name: Madness
keywords.how: A replacement effect (discard exiles instead of going to graveyard) plus a triggered ability granting an alternative-cost cast of the exiled card.

keywords.name: Max Speed
keywords.how: Conditional static: 'as long as your speed is 4, this object has [ability]' — grants an ability gated on reading the player's speed progress track.

keywords.name: Mayhem
keywords.how: Static in the graveyard: alternative-cost cast (or play) from the graveyard if you discarded this card this turn — conditional alt-cost casting from graveyard.

keywords.name: Melee
keywords.how: Triggered ability: whenever this creature attacks, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each opponent you attacked this combat.

keywords.name: Menace
keywords.how: Cant(BlockSet(S, This) where |S| < 2) — set-level evasion restriction; evaluated over the whole blocker declaration set (702.111b).

keywords.name: Mentor
keywords.how: Triggered ability: attack trigger placing a +1/+1 counter on a target attacking creature with lower power.

keywords.name: Miracle
keywords.how: Static ability linked to a triggered ability: may reveal as you draw it if it's the first card drawn this turn, and when revealed this way you may cast it for the miracle cost; draw-event reveal option + reveal trigger + alternative-cost cast.

keywords.name: Mobilize
keywords.how: Attack-triggered ability creating N 1/1 Warrior tokens tapped and attacking, sacrificed at the next end step — combat trigger + create-token (entering attacking) + delayed sacrifice.

keywords.name: Modular
keywords.how: An enters-with-N-counters static plus a leaves-battlefield trigger that moves those counters to a target artifact creature.

keywords.name: More Than Meets the Eye
keywords.how: Static alternative-cost permission to cast the card converted rather than for its mana cost; follows the alternative-cost casting rules (601.2b/f–h) plus a convert action.

keywords.name: Morph
keywords.how: Alternative-cost face-down cast (708) of the card as a 2/2 face-down creature plus a special action (116) to turn it face up; given the face-down-objects primitive it is alt-cost cast + turn-face-up, the same shape as Disguise/Manifest/Cloak with no unique non-708 machinery.

keywords.name: Mutate
keywords.how: Alternative cost that makes the spell a targeting mutating creature spell which, on resolution, merges with the target into a single object represented by multiple cards (rule 730); merging is non-standard object machinery not reproducible by composition.

keywords.name: Myriad
keywords.how: Triggered ability creating tapped-and-attacking token copies for each other opponent, plus a delayed triggered ability to exile them at end of combat.

keywords.name: Nightbound
keywords.how: Two statics that read the game day/night designation (game-maintained track, rule 731): transform as it becomes day, can’t otherwise transform; given the day/night progress-track these are statics + forced transforms.

keywords.name: Ninjutsu
keywords.how: An activated ability usable only from hand: cost + reveal + return an unblocked attacker, putting this card onto the battlefield tapped and attacking (cost components + put-onto-battlefield).

keywords.name: Offering
keywords.how: An additional-cost option (sacrifice a qualifying permanent) that reduces total cost by the sacrificed permanent's mana cost and grants flash timing.

keywords.name: Offspring
keywords.how: Optional additional cost plus an ETB triggered ability that creates a 1/1 token copy if the offspring cost was paid — additional-cost choice + conditional ETB token-copy.

keywords.name: Outlast
keywords.how: Activated ability: [cost], {T}: put a +1/+1 counter on this creature, sorcery-speed restricted.

keywords.name: Overload
keywords.how: Two static abilities on the stack: an alternative-cost permission and, if chosen, a text-changing effect replacing 'target' with 'each'; alternative-cost + text-changing effect (612).

keywords.name: Paradigm
keywords.how: Spell abilities creating a delayed triggered ability that, on first resolution of a same-named spell, makes castable free copies each precombat main phase, plus exiling this spell — spell ability + delayed trigger + create-copy-in-exile.

keywords.name: Partner
keywords.how: Static deck-construction modifier functioning before the game (designate two legendary commanders); 'partner with' also adds an ETB tutor trigger. Sits at the edge of the gameplay basis since it changes prospective deck-construction legality, but no in-game opcode is needed.

keywords.name: Persist
keywords.how: Triggered ability: dies-from-battlefield trigger with intervening-if (had no -1/-1 counters) returning it with a -1/-1 counter; LTB-to-graveyard trigger + conditional + return/place counter.

keywords.name: Phasing
keywords.how: Modifies the untap step (phase out/in turn-based action) and introduces the phased-out status, a fundamental existence/visibility state in which the permanent is treated as not existing without changing zones; not reproducible from primitives.

keywords.name: Plot
keywords.how: Special action to exile a card from hand paying a cost (becoming plotted), then later alternative-cost casting from exile without paying mana — special action + alt-cost cast + a plotted marker.

keywords.name: Poisonous
keywords.how: Triggered ability: whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player gets N poison counters; combat-damage trigger + place counters.

keywords.name: Protection
keywords.how: Cant(Target(x, This) where Q(x)) ∧ Cant(Enchant/Equip(x, This) where Q(x)) ∧ Cant(Block(b, This) where Q(b)) ∧ Damage from Q-sources prevented (event-edit leg) — DEBT bundle (702.16b–f).

keywords.name: Prototype
keywords.how: Static ability offering a casting choice to use an alternative set of power/toughness/mana cost characteristics for the spell and resulting permanent.

keywords.name: Provoke
keywords.how: Must(Block(t, This)) via triggered ability: when This attacks, may choose target defender creature; if chosen, that creature must block This if able and is untapped — block requirement installed by trigger resolution (702.39a).

keywords.name: Prowess
keywords.how: Triggered ability: whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

keywords.name: Prowl
keywords.how: Static alternative-cost permission on the stack gated on a condition (a source you controlled sharing this spell's creature type dealt combat damage this turn); alternative-cost + game-history predicate.

keywords.name: Rampage
keywords.how: Triggered ability: whenever this becomes blocked, it gets +N/+N for each blocker beyond the first; a become-blocked trigger producing a P/T-pump continuous effect.

keywords.name: Ravenous
keywords.how: Replacement effect (enters with X +1/+1 counters) plus an ETB triggered ability drawing a card if X is 5+.

keywords.name: Reach
keywords.how: Has no function of its own; meaning lives entirely in flying's blocking predicate (702.9b), which lets reach creatures block fliers.

keywords.name: Read Ahead
keywords.how: Static restriction on when a Saga's chapter abilities can trigger (only at the exact lore count) plus intrinsic enter-choosing-lore-count abilities (replacement on lore counters); restriction + replacement.

keywords.name: Rebound
keywords.how: Static replacement (if cast from hand, exile instead of going to graveyard on resolution) creating a delayed triggered ability to cast it for free next upkeep; resolution-zone replacement + delayed trigger + free cast.

keywords.name: Reconfigure
keywords.how: Two sorcery-speed activated abilities (attach to a creature you control / unattach) using the attachment relation; attaching an Equipment with it stops it being a creature.

keywords.name: Recover
keywords.how: A graveyard-functioning trigger when a creature dies: optionally pay [cost] to return this card to hand, otherwise exile it.

keywords.name: Reinforce
keywords.how: Activated ability from hand = [cost], discard this card : put N +1/+1 counters on target creature; cost + discard keyword-action + targeting + place counters.

keywords.name: Renown
keywords.how: Triggered ability: on combat damage to a player, if not renowned, put N +1/+1 counters and become renowned (a marker designation other abilities read).

keywords.name: Replicate
keywords.how: An additional-cost static (pay [cost] any number of times) plus a cast-trigger copying the spell once per payment, with optional new targets.

keywords.name: Retrace
keywords.how: Static permission to cast this card from the graveyard with discarding a land card as an additional cost; cast-from-alternate-zone permission + additional-cost.

keywords.name: Riot
keywords.how: Static replacement-style choice as the permanent enters: either an extra +1/+1 counter or it gains haste.

keywords.name: Ripple
keywords.how: A cast-trigger that reveals the top N cards, lets you cast same-named cards without paying mana costs, then bottoms the rest (sequence of reveal/cast-free/move actions).

keywords.name: Saddle
keywords.how: Activated sorcery-speed ability: tap other untapped creatures with total power N+ to make this permanent 'saddled' until end of turn — cost (tap components) producing a marker designation.

keywords.name: Scavenge
keywords.how: Activated ability from graveyard = [cost], exile this card : put +1/+1 counters equal to the exiled card's power on target creature, sorcery-speed; cost + exile keyword-action + targeting + place counters + timing restriction.

keywords.name: Shadow
keywords.how: Cant(Block(b, This) where ¬Shadow(b)) ∧ Cant(Block(This, a) where Shadow(a) ∧ ¬Shadow(This)) — bidirectional evasion restriction over the shadow keyword (702.28b).

keywords.name: Shroud
keywords.how: Cant(Target(x, This)) for all sources — symmetric targeting restriction (702.18a).

keywords.name: Skulk
keywords.how: Cant(Block(b, This) where Power(b) > Power(This)) — evasion restriction over blocker power (702.118b).

keywords.name: Sneak
keywords.how: Static on the stack: alternative-cost cast at instant timing during declare-blockers, paying [cost] and returning an unblocked creature; the spell enters tapped and attacking per 506.3a — alt-cost casting + bounce + enters-attacking.

keywords.name: Solved
keywords.how: Meta-keyword wrapping a static, triggered, or activated ability gated on the Case being solved ('as long as solved' / 'triggers only if solved' / 'activate only if solved') — a condition-gate over the existing ability templates.

keywords.name: Soulbond
keywords.how: Two triggered abilities (this enters / another creature you control enters) that optionally pair two unpaired creatures, with pairing tracked as a relation that breaks on control change or leaving; ETB triggers + pairing relation memory.

keywords.name: Soulshift
keywords.how: A dies-trigger that may return a target Spirit card of mana value N or less from your graveyard to hand.

keywords.name: Space Sculptor
keywords.how: Static ability whose presence causes a state-based action (704.5u) assigning sector designations (markers) to creatures lacking them.

keywords.name: Spectacle
keywords.how: Static ability on the stack granting an alternative cost, payable if an opponent lost life this turn; follows alternative-cost rules.

keywords.name: Splice
keywords.how: A static letting you reveal the card as you cast a qualifying spell to add its rules text (a text-changing effect, 612.10) and pay an additional cost.

keywords.name: Split Second
keywords.how: A static restriction while on the stack: players can't cast other spells or activate non-mana abilities (a continuous restriction on the legality of those actions).

keywords.name: Spree
keywords.how: Static on the stack: choose one or more modes and pay their associated costs as additional costs — modal selection plus additional-cost payment.

keywords.name: Squad
keywords.how: Static additional cost payable any number of times plus a linked ETB trigger creating a token copy per payment.

keywords.name: Start Your Engines!
keywords.how: Static SBA that sets a player's speed to 1 plus an inherent triggered ability increasing speed when opponents lose life — initializes and advances the speed progress track given native player-speed state.

keywords.name: Station
keywords.how: Activated sorcery-speed ability: tap another untapped creature to put charge counters equal to its power on this permanent — cost (tap) + place-counters action.

keywords.name: Storm
keywords.how: A cast-trigger that copies the spell for each other spell cast earlier this turn, with optional new targets (trigger + copy-spell over a spells-cast-this-turn count).

keywords.name: Sunburst
keywords.how: An enters-with-counters static parameterized by the number of colors of mana spent to cast it (enters-with counters over a mana-spent record).

keywords.name: Surge
keywords.how: Static alternative-cost permission conditioned on you or a teammate having cast another spell this turn.

keywords.name: Suspend
keywords.how: A special action to exile the card with N time counters, an upkeep trigger removing a counter, and a last-counter trigger granting a free alternative-cost cast (special action + triggers over a time-counter track).

keywords.name: Tiered
keywords.how: Static on the stack: choose one mode and pay its cost as an additional cost — modal selection plus additional-cost payment.

keywords.name: Toxic
keywords.how: Augments the result of combat damage to a player: in addition to damage's other results, give poison counters equal to total toxic value (120.3g) — a damage-result augmentation given the damage-result-rewrite stage, like lifelink/infect.

keywords.name: Training
keywords.how: Triggered ability: triggers when this and a higher-power creature attack, placing a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

keywords.name: Trample
keywords.how: Modifies the prospective combat damage assignment rules (510.1c–d): controller must assign lethal to blockers first, then may assign excess to the defending player/planeswalker.

keywords.name: Transfigure
keywords.how: Activated ability = [cost], sacrifice this : tutor a creature with equal mana value onto the battlefield then shuffle, sorcery-speed only; cost + sacrifice keyword-action + search/move + timing restriction.

keywords.name: Transmute
keywords.how: An activated ability usable only from hand (cost + discard this card) to tutor a card with the same mana value, with a sorcery-speed timing restriction.

keywords.name: Tribute
keywords.how: Static enter replacement: an opponent chooses whether the creature enters with N extra +1/+1 counters, plus a 'tribute wasn't paid' memory predicate other triggers read.

keywords.name: Umbra Armor
keywords.how: Static replacement on an Aura: if enchanted permanent would be destroyed, instead remove all marked damage and destroy this Aura; destruction-event replacement effect.

keywords.name: Undaunted
keywords.how: Static cost-reduction ability: costs {1} less for each opponent you have.

keywords.name: Undying
keywords.how: Triggered ability: dies-from-battlefield trigger with intervening-if (had no +1/+1 counters) returning it with a +1/+1 counter; LTB-to-graveyard trigger + conditional + return/place counter.

keywords.name: Unearth
keywords.how: Activated ability from graveyard = [cost] : return this to battlefield, it gains haste, exile it at next end step, exile-instead-of-leaving replacement, sorcery-speed; cost + return keyword-action + granted haste + delayed exile trigger + leave-replacement.

keywords.name: Unleash
keywords.how: Two static abilities: an enter-with-additional-+1/+1-counter replacement option, plus a can't-block restriction conditioned on having a +1/+1 counter.

keywords.name: Vanishing
keywords.how: An enters-with-N-time-counters static, an upkeep trigger removing a counter, and a last-counter-removed trigger that sacrifices the permanent.

keywords.name: Vigilance
keywords.how: Dedicated rules text inside the attack-declaration procedure: 702.20a names it a static ability that modifies the rules for the declare attackers step, and 702.20b exempts the creature from 508.1f's attack-tap — the same justification shape as trample owning 510.1c-d. Hypothetical decomposition (documented, not adopted): a null-replacement on tap(cause: attack-declaration) given cause-tagged events; that primitive was retired as sole-dependent under the dependents threshold (keyword-classification.md).

keywords.name: Visit
keywords.how: Triggered ability: triggers when you roll to visit your Attractions and the result matches a lit number, doing the effect.

keywords.name: Ward
keywords.how: Toll(resolve(spell/ability targeting This), pay {N}) — the resolution-stage MayIf flavor (deontics.md Gate/Toll split) via triggered counter-unless-pays (702.21a).

keywords.name: Warp
keywords.how: Alternative-cost cast from hand plus a delayed triggered ability exiling the permanent at the next end step with a recast permission — alt-cost casting + delayed-trigger exile + cast-from-exile.

keywords.name: Web-slinging
keywords.how: Static on the stack: alternative-cost cast paying [cost] and returning a tapped creature you control to hand rather than the mana cost — alt-cost casting with a bounce cost component.

keywords.name: Wither
keywords.how: Static result substitution: damage dealt to a creature by a wither source is put as that many -1/-1 counters instead of being marked, given the damage-result-rewrite stage (CR 120.3d).

keywords.name: ∞ (Infinity)
keywords.how: Conditional static: 'as long as this permanent is harnessed, it has [ability]' — grants an ability gated on the harnessed designation marker (701.64).

keywords.name: Abandon
keywords.how: Variant (Archenemy) macro: turn a face-up ongoing scheme face down and put it on the bottom of the scheme deck. A turn-face-down + move sequence.

keywords.name: Activate
keywords.how: Defines the activated-ability casting-pipeline analog: put ability on stack and pay costs (601-structured). A native engine opcode for putting an object on the stack and paying costs; the primitive basis other abilities reference.

keywords.name: Adapt
keywords.how: Macro: if the permanent has no +1/+1 counters, put N +1/+1 counters on it.

keywords.name: Airbend
keywords.how: Macro: exile the chosen objects, and grant each exiled card's owner permission to cast it from exile for {2} (exile + alternative-cost casting permission).

keywords.name: Amass
keywords.how: Macro: create a 0/0 Army token if you control none, choose an Army, put N +1/+1 counters on it, and add the subtype if absent.

keywords.name: Assemble
keywords.how: Un-set action that puts Contraptions onto the battlefield; not part of standard rules, but decomposes to a put-onto-battlefield macro.

keywords.name: Attach
keywords.how: Moves an Aura/Equipment/Fortification into the attached-to relation with a legal object/player (with no-op/legality guards and new timestamp). Decomposes given the engine models the attachment relation as a primitive.

keywords.name: Behold
keywords.how: Macro: 'reveal a [quality] card from hand OR choose a [quality] permanent you control' plus a 'was beheld' memory snapshot. Compiles to a choice over the reveal action and a choose-permanent action.

keywords.name: Blight
keywords.how: Macro: put N -1/-1 counters on a creature you control (with a legality gate and a 'blighted creature' reference).

keywords.name: Bolster
keywords.how: Macro: choose a creature you control with least (or tied-for-least) toughness, then put N +1/+1 counters on it.

keywords.name: Cast
keywords.how: Defines the casting-pipeline event (601): take from zone, put on stack, pay costs. The fundamental spell-creation primitive the entire casting machinery hangs on.

keywords.name: Clash
keywords.how: Macro: reveal top card, optionally move it to bottom; 'clash with an opponent' = choose opponent and both clash; winner determined by mana-value comparison. A sequence of reveal/move actions plus a comparison.

keywords.name: Cloak
keywords.how: Like manifest but the 2/2 face-down creature has ward {2} (708); special action (116) to turn face up; given the face-down-objects primitive, put-onto-battlefield-face-down + turn-face-up.

keywords.name: Collect Evidence
keywords.how: Macro: exile any number of cards from your graveyard with total mana value >= N (with a legality gate and linked 'evidence collected' memory).

keywords.name: Connive
keywords.how: Macro: draw a card, discard a card, then put a +1/+1 counter on the permanent if a nonland card was discarded (N is a count loop).

keywords.name: Convert
keywords.how: Identical face-flip primitive to Transform (explicitly follows 701.27a-f), differing only in name/event-tag; same once-per-stack guard. Native face-state machinery; can't-transform also blocks convert.

keywords.name: Counter
keywords.how: Defines cancel/remove-from-stack event: object doesn't resolve, no effects occur, countered spell goes to graveyard, no cost refund. A primitive stack-removal opcode other abilities target.

keywords.name: Create
keywords.how: Instantiates tokens onto the battlefield with specified characteristics; carries token-specific replacement-effect ordering (701.7b) distinct from generic ETB. A native token-instantiation primitive.

keywords.name: Destroy
keywords.how: Defines the battlefield-to-graveyard destruction event that regeneration replaces and that SBA lethal-damage/deathtouch checks invoke; only 'destroy'-word effects and those SBAs cause it. A primitive event the engine must distinguish from generic moves.

keywords.name: Detain
keywords.how: Applies a continuous restriction effect (can't attack/block; activated abilities can't be activated) on a permanent with a duration ending at the spell/ability controller's next turn.

keywords.name: Discard
keywords.how: Defines hand-to-graveyard event with default-chooser/random/opponent-chooser modes and the hidden-zone undefined-characteristics / illegal-cost-rewind nuance. These randomness and replacement subtleties make it a primitive event other rules read.

keywords.name: Discover
keywords.how: Macro: exile from top of library until a nonland of mana value <= N, then either cast it without paying mana cost or put it in hand, and bottom the rest randomly; composes exile + cast-without-paying.

keywords.name: Double
keywords.how: Compiles to existing effects: a layer-7c continuous +X/+0 P/T modifier, life gain/loss to twice current, adding equal counters/mana, or a damage-doubling replacement effect. No new machinery beyond the layer system and replacement effects.

keywords.name: Earthbend
keywords.how: Macro: target land becomes a 0/0 land creature with haste (CDA), put N +1/+1 counters on it, and create a delayed triggered ability returning it if it dies/exiles.

keywords.name: Endure
keywords.how: Macro: create an N/N white Spirit token OR put N +1/+1 counters on the permanent (controller's choice; 0 does nothing).

keywords.name: Exchange
keywords.how: Resolution-time swap that compiles to existing primitives: simultaneous control changes, life gain/loss to match, set-value continuous effects, or zone swaps; all-or-nothing if uncompletable. Composes from control-change, life-change, and set effects.

keywords.name: Exert
keywords.how: Choose to apply a continuous 'doesn't untap during your next untap step' effect to a permanent; just a duration-limited untap-restriction effect.

keywords.name: Exile
keywords.how: Primitive zone-move into the exile zone. A fundamental move event referenced as a destination by many effects; the basis-level relocation opcode.

keywords.name: Explore
keywords.how: Macro: reveal top card; if land put in hand, else put +1/+1 counter on the permanent and may put revealed card in graveyard.

keywords.name: Face a Villainous Choice
keywords.how: Macro: a player chooses one of two listed options, then performs all actions in the chosen option (with APNAP/illegality exceptions to 608.2d-e); a structured choice + action sequence.

keywords.name: Fateseal
keywords.how: Macro: look at top N of an OPPONENT's library, distribute between top and bottom (any order). Same look/move sequence as scry but on an opponent's library.

keywords.name: Fight
keywords.how: Macro: each creature deals damage equal to its power to the other (non-combat damage), with legality/illegal-target guards. Compiles to two simultaneous deal-damage actions.

keywords.name: Forage
keywords.how: Macro: exile three cards from your graveyard OR sacrifice a Food (a choice between two cost-like actions).

keywords.name: Goad
keywords.how: Must(Attack(This)) ∧ Must(Attack-target(This, ¬goader)) — stacked attack requirements arbitrated by 508.1d maximization (701.15b–c).

keywords.name: Harness
keywords.how: Macro: if not harnessed, apply the 'harnessed' designation (a marker with no rules meaning beyond identification by other abilities).

keywords.name: Incubate
keywords.how: Macro: create a (double-faced) Incubator token entering with N +1/+1 counters.

keywords.name: Investigate
keywords.how: Pure macro: 'create a Clue token.' Expands directly to the Create action.

keywords.name: Learn
keywords.how: Macro: may discard then draw; if you didn't discard, may reveal a Lesson card from outside the game and put it into hand.

keywords.name: Manifest
keywords.how: Puts a card onto the battlefield as a 2/2 face-down creature (708) plus a special action (116) to turn it face up by paying its mana cost; given the face-down-objects primitive it is put-onto-battlefield-face-down + turn-face-up.

keywords.name: Manifest Dread
keywords.how: Look at top two, manifest one (put it onto the battlefield as a 2/2 face-down creature, 708) and graveyard the rest; built on manifest, so given the face-down-objects primitive it is look + manifest + move.

keywords.name: Meld
keywords.how: Macro: put both cards of a meld pair onto the battlefield back-faces-up and combined as a single object; relies on existing double-faced/meld card machinery (712).

keywords.name: Mill
keywords.how: Macro: move the top N cards of library to graveyard (can't exceed library size). A sequence over the zone-move primitive; milled-card references are public-zone lookups.

keywords.name: Monstrosity
keywords.how: Macro: if not monstrous, put N +1/+1 counters and set the 'monstrous' designation (a marker with no rules meaning beyond being identified by other abilities).

keywords.name: Open an Attraction
keywords.how: Macro: move the top card off your Attraction deck, turn it face up, and put it onto the battlefield under your control.

keywords.name: Planeswalk
keywords.how: Variant (Planechase) macro: put face-up plane/phenomenon cards to bottom of planar deck face down, then move top of planar deck up and turn it face up. A sequence of move/turn-face actions over the planar deck.

keywords.name: Play
keywords.how: Defines the land-play special action (116): put land onto battlefield without using the stack under the once-per-turn/main-phase/empty-stack timing constraints, plus dispatch to cast for non-lands. The non-stack land-play machinery is native turn-structure/priority machinery.

keywords.name: Populate
keywords.how: Macro: choose a creature token you control, then create a token that is a copy of it (no token => no creation).

keywords.name: Proliferate
keywords.how: Macro: choose any number of permanents/players that have a counter, then give each one more of each kind it already has (with 2HG poison sharing). A selector plus the place-counters primitive, the rubric's stated composite example.

keywords.name: Regenerate
keywords.how: CR 614.8 states regeneration IS a destruction-replacement effect: “the next time this would be destroyed, instead remove all marked damage, its controller taps it, and remove it from combat.” Replacement/prevention effects are in the rubric basis, so this composes from a destroy-event replacement + remove-damage + tap + remove-from-combat.

keywords.name: Reveal
keywords.how: Primitive information event: show card to all players with a defined revealed-state lifetime, without changing zone, and with the rule that reordered revealed cards become new objects. The revealed-state tracking and object-identity interaction make it a basis primitive.

keywords.name: Roll to Visit Your Attractions
keywords.how: Macro: roll a d6, then any controlled Attraction with that number lit is 'visited' and its visit ability triggers; a die roll feeding triggered abilities.

keywords.name: Sacrifice
keywords.how: Defines the controller-only battlefield-to-graveyard event that is NOT destruction and so bypasses destruction-replacement (regeneration). A distinct primitive move event the engine must separate from destroy.

keywords.name: Scry
keywords.how: Macro: look at top N, then distribute between top (any order) and bottom (any order); scry-0 no-op; APNAP simultaneity. A sequence of look/move actions, the rubric exemplar of composite.

keywords.name: Search
keywords.how: Primitive look-at-all-cards-in-a-zone (even hidden) and find-matching operation, with optional-find / undefined-quality / search-replacement (search-portion) and library-searched triggers. The hidden-zone look + find-legality machinery is a basis primitive other effects build on.

keywords.name: Set in Motion
keywords.how: Variant (Archenemy) macro: move a scheme off the scheme deck and/or turn it face up; one at a time. A sequence of move/turn-face actions over the scheme deck.

keywords.name: Shuffle
keywords.how: Primitive randomize-a-library operation with subtleties: excludes searched-then-found cards, fires shuffle triggers even on empty/single-card libraries and per-effect, and resolves simultaneous put-into-position. A native randomization primitive.

keywords.name: Support
keywords.how: Macro: put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to N target creatures (other creatures if on a permanent).

keywords.name: Surveil
keywords.how: Macro: look at top N, then distribute between graveyard and top (any order); surveil-0 no-op. A sequence of look/move actions like scry.

keywords.name: Suspect
keywords.how: Macro: apply the 'suspected' designation to a creature, which grants the static abilities menace and 'can't block' while suspected.

keywords.name: Tap
keywords.how: Primitive that flips the tapped/untapped status (only untapped can be tapped). The boolean status the engine must track natively; cost payments, attack declaration, and many rules read/write it.

keywords.name: The Ring Tempts You
keywords.how: Macro: choose a creature to gain the Ring-bearer designation, granting/upgrading 'The Ring' emblem whose tier-gated static and triggered abilities reference the Ring-bearer.

keywords.name: Time Travel
keywords.how: Macro: choose any number of your objects bearing time counters (permanents/suspended cards) and add or remove a time counter on each; a selector + counter manipulation over the suspend/vanishing machinery.

keywords.name: Transform
keywords.how: Primitive face-flip on a DFC/DFT, a distinct game event from turn-face-up/down, with a once-per-stack guard against re-transforming and 'transformed permanent' status. The native face-state machinery and event identity make it a basis primitive.

keywords.name: Triple
keywords.how: Same as Double: a layer-7c continuous P/T modifier (+2X) built on the existing layer system. No new machinery.

keywords.name: Untap
keywords.how: Primitive that flips status back to untapped (only tapped can be untapped). The complementary native status-write to Tap.

keywords.name: Venture into the Dungeon
keywords.how: Macro over the dungeon subsystem (309): place/advance the venture marker among rooms following arrows, completing and re-choosing dungeons; sequenced marker moves + choices.

keywords.name: Vote
keywords.how: Structured choice procedure: each player in turn order chooses one listed option; resolution then reads the vote tally. Just sequenced player choices.

keywords.name: Waterbend
keywords.how: Pay [cost]; for each generic mana in that cost, may tap an untapped artifact/creature rather than pay that mana (701.67b limits the substitution to the waterbend cost’s generic component). Same cost-modification-hook pay-substitution as Delve/Convoke/Improvise.
